items.title: Nemesia’s Descent | EXODUSER: HELL LORD — Opening Cinematic
items.description:
Nemesia’s Descent — the opening cinematic of EXODUSER: HELL LORD, reconstructed from the game’s existing artwork, Korean dialogue, current English localization and “네메시아의 강림 V3” music.

English text is displayed first, with supporting Korean text. Dialogue timing has been adapted for reading: the game waits for player input, while this edited cinematic advances automatically. This is a cinematic reconstruction rather than a gameplay recording.

Play the free Windows demo on Steam. Open the store page and select “Download EXODUSER: HELL LORD Demo”:
The Steam demo link is also available in our channel profile.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749590/EXODUSER_HELL_LORD/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=foreign_pilot_202610&utm_content=nemesia_intro

Production disclosure: This edit reuses existing pre-produced AI-assisted artwork and music. No new AI artwork, music or voice was generated for this reconstruction.

items.title: Rift Devlog v0.1 — Work in Progress | EXODUSER: HELL LORD
items.description:
The Rift, in development — a short record of EXODUSER: HELL LORD's space between battles.

v0.1 is this devlog series label. This is a work-in-progress preview, with resident placement, passage and stair checks. Movement and visibility polish are planned for later development updates.

Sources: October 5, 2026 concept art and October 6, 2026 automated development QA footage. The selected clips are edited in chronological order. This is not a newly recorded human play session, and the Rift is not confirmed as included in the public Steam demo.

Play the separate free Windows demo on Steam:
The Steam demo link is also available in our channel profile.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749590/EXODUSER_HELL_LORD/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=foreign_pilot_202610&utm_content=rift_devlog_v01

Existing project music was added to the silent QA capture. This edit reuses pre-produced AI-assisted art and music; no new AI assets were generated for this video.
